title: Later — Expand only after the first reliable loop
description: Candidate capabilities retained for review, outside the initial release: richer desktop/web experience, more providers, larger parallel work and broader protocols. These are not committed implementation scope.
why: Keep the long-term direction visible without turning the prototype into infrastructure work.

acceptance.text: Each expansion has a demonstrated use case and a separate scope decision

outcome.summary: Later work gated in docs/later/expansion-gate.md; children MAST-42/43 closed deferred.
